pr_title: Create a generic operator SqlToS3Operator and deprecate the MySqlToS3Operator.
pr_body:
Rename the operator MySqlToS3Operator to SqlToS3Operator by using DbApiHook insteand of MysqlHook.

This makes the operator more generic and add support to all databases that extends DbApiHook.

Closes: #11128

issue_context.title: SqlToS3Operator
